split SubStatement ::= OpKeywordSub SubNameExpr SubDefinition => SubStatement ::= OpKeywordSub SubDefName SubDefinition
split SubDeclaration ::= OpKeywordSub SubNameExpr => SubDeclaration ::= OpKeywordSub SubDefName
split GlobalVarExpr ::= '$#' => GlobalVarExpr ::= DollarHashVar
split GlobalVarExpr ::= SigilScalar GlobalVariables ElemSeq0 => GlobalVarExpr ::= SpecialScalarVar ElemSeq0
split GlobalVarExpr ::= SigilArray GlobalVariables ElemSeq0 => GlobalVarExpr ::= SpecialArrayVar ElemSeq0
split GlobalVarExpr ::= SigilHash GlobalVariables ElemSeq0 => GlobalVarExpr ::= SpecialHashVar ElemSeq0
split GlobalVarExpr ::= SigilGlob GlobalVariables ElemSeq0 => GlobalVarExpr ::= GlobSigil SpecialGlobName ElemSeq0
split VarScalar ::= SigilScalar VarIdentExpr ElemSeq0 => VarScalar ::= ScalarVar ElemSeq0
split VarArray ::= SigilArray VarIdentExpr ElemSeq0 => VarArray ::= ArrayVar ElemSeq0
split VarHash ::= SigilHash VarIdentExpr ElemSeq0 => VarHash ::= HashVar ElemSeq0
split VarCode ::= SigilCode VarIdentExpr => VarCode ::= CodeSigil CodeName
split VarGlob ::= SigilGlob VarIdentExpr => VarGlob ::= GlobSigil GlobName
split VarArrayTop ::= SigilArrayTop VarIdentExpr => VarArrayTop ::= ArrayTopVar
split VarArrayTop ::= '$#_' => VarArrayTop ::= ArgsTopVar
split ArrowIndirectCall ::= SigilScalar VarIdentExpr CallArgs => ArrowIndirectCall ::= ScalarVar CallArgs
split DerefVariableSlice ::= '@[' Expression ']' => DerefVariableSlice ::= SliceArraySigil LBracket Expression RBracket
split DerefVariableSlice ::= '@{' Expression '}' => DerefVariableSlice ::= SliceArraySigil LBrace Expression RBrace
split DerefVariableSlice ::= '%[' Expression ']' => DerefVariableSlice ::= SliceHashSigil LBracket Expression RBracket
split DerefVariableSlice ::= '%{' Expression '}' => DerefVariableSlice ::= SliceHashSigil LBrace Expression RBrace
split DerefVariable ::= SigilScalar BlockNonEmpty => DerefVariable ::= DerefScalarSigil BlockNonEmpty
split DerefVariable ::= SigilArray BlockNonEmpty ElemSeq0 => DerefVariable ::= DerefArraySigil BlockNonEmpty ElemSeq0
split DerefVariable ::= SigilHash BlockNonEmpty ElemSeq0 => DerefVariable ::= DerefHashSigil BlockNonEmpty ElemSeq0
split DerefVariable ::= SigilGlob BlockNonEmpty => DerefVariable ::= GlobSigil BlockNonEmpty
split DerefVariable ::= SigilArrayTop BlockNonEmpty => DerefVariable ::= ArrayTopBlockVar
absorb VarIdentExpr ::= VarIdent | VarIdentExpr PackageSep VarIdent
token ScalarVar => Variable ~ SigilScalar VarIdentExpr
token ArrayVar => Variable ~ SigilArray VarIdentExpr
token HashVar => Variable ~ SigilHash VarIdentExpr
token ArrayTopVar => Variable ~ SigilArrayTop VarIdentExpr
token SpecialScalarVar => Variable ~ SigilScalar GlobalVariables
token SpecialArrayVar => Variable ~ SigilArray GlobalVariables
token SpecialHashVar => Variable ~ SigilHash GlobalVariables
token DollarHashVar => Variable '$#'
token ArgsTopVar => Variable '$#_'
token CodeSigil => FuncSigil ~ SigilCode
token CodeName => Word ~ VarIdentExpr
token GlobSigil => Operator ~ SigilGlob
token GlobName => Word ~ VarIdentExpr
token SpecialGlobName => Word ~ GlobalVariables | Number ~ GlobalVariables
token DerefScalarSigil => DerefSigil ~ SigilScalar
token DerefArraySigil => DerefSigil ~ SigilArray
token DerefHashSigil => DerefSigil ~ SigilHash
token ArrayTopBlockVar => Variable ~ SigilArrayTop '{' ScalarVar '}' | Variable ~ SigilArrayTop '{' SpecialScalarVar '}'
token SliceArraySigil => Variable ~ SigilArray
token SliceHashSigil => Variable ~ SigilHash
token SubDefName => Word ~ SubNameExpr except PhaseName
collapse Diamond ::= '<' VarScalar '>' | '<' BuiltinFilehandle '>' | '<>' => Readline ~ '<' ScalarVar '>' | Readline ~ '<' BuiltinFilehandle '>' | Readline '<>'
collapse DoubleDiamond ::= '<<' VarScalar '>>' | '<<' BuiltinFilehandle '>>' | '<<>>' => Readline ~ '<<' ScalarVar '>>' | Readline ~ '<<' BuiltinFilehandle '>>' | Readline '<<>>'
collapse SubNameCallExpr ::= SubNameNonQLike | SubNameCallExpr PackageSep SubNameNonQLike => Word ~ SubNameCallExpr except :priority
collapse SubNameExpr ::= SubName | SubNameExpr PackageSep SubName => Word ~ SubNameExpr

NonExclamPointOrEscapedExclamPoints_Any '!' | QLikeFunction '|' NonPipeOrEscapedPipes_Any '|' => Quote ~ QLikeValueExpr
collapse QLikeValueExprWithMods ~ QLikeFunctionWithMods '(' NonRParenOrEscapedParens_Any ')' RegexModifiers | QLikeFunctionWithMods '{' NonRBraceOrEscapedBraces_Any '}' RegexModifiers | QLikeFunctionWithMods '<' NonRAngleOrEscapedAngles_Any '>' RegexModifiers | QLikeFunctionWithMods '[' NonRBracketOrEscapedBrackets_Any ']' RegexModifiers | QLikeFunctionWithMods '/' NonForwardSlashOrEscapedForwardSlashes_Any '/' RegexModifiers | QLikeFunctionWithMods '!' NonExclamPointOrEscapedExclamPoints_Any '!' NonExclamPointOrEscapedExclamPoints_Any '!' RegexModifiers | QLikeSubstWithMods '|' NonPipeOrEscapedPipes_Any '|' NonPipeOrEscapedPipes_Any '|' RegexModifiers | '/' NonForwardSlashOrEscapedForwardSlashes_Any '/' RegexModifiers | '`' NonBacktickOrEscapedBackticks_Any '`' => Quote ~ QLikeValueExprWithMods
